title: One of every four decoder layers in Qwen3.8-Flash-Next utilizes Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA) rather than linear attention, pairing full self-attention expressive power with an MQA micro-block indexer to bound sequence compute within an active token budget. Implementing QSA requires partial interleaved multimodal Rotary Position Embedding (mRoPE), key-pooled micro-block indexing returning selected block indices, and gated query-output projection aligned with reference PyTorch semantics.
